C1541.title: Resolv Protocol Hack
C1541.summary: In March 2026, the Resolv DeFi protocol was attacked. Using only about $100,000 USDC, the attacker exploited a critical flaw in the USR minting function (the root cause was not finalized by the official team; possible explanations include oracle manipulation, off-chain signer key compromise, or missing minting amount validation) to mint approximately 80 million USR out of thin air, then cashed out about $23 million via liquidity pools such as Curve, causing USR to de-peg.
